reasoning: The evidence shows Orbán has announced his candidacy for PM in the April 2026 elections, so he will lead Fidesz. However, polls consistently show opposition party Tisza leading by 8-10 percentage points (49% vs 39% in January 2026). Hungary's electoral system has been modified by Fidesz to favor them, and Orbán has consolidated power over institutions. Despite the polling deficit, Hungary's electoral system advantages Fidesz in rural areas and single-member constituencies. Historical precedent shows Fidesz has outperformed polls before. However, the 10-point gap is substantial, and there's genuine momentum behind Magyar's Tisza party. Given the structural advantages Fidesz has built but the significant polling deficit, I estimate roughly 40% chance Orbán becomes PM if he leads a party.
